title: Mixamo
author: Adobe
summary: Huge free library of auto-rigged characters and mocap clips. Download FBX, convert/import into Godot for prototyping fast.

title: AccuRIG
author: Reallusion
summary: Free auto-rigging tool for humanoid meshes — get a usable skeleton without a full DCC pipeline.

title: Cascadeur (Free)
author: Nekki
summary: Physics-assisted keyframe animation. The free plan is solid for indie Godot characters and cinematic posing.

title: Blender
author: Blender Foundation
summary: The free full-stack DCC for rigs, keyframes, Grease Pencil 2D, and glTF export straight into Godot.

title: Godot Animation Docs
author: Godot Engine
summary: Official tutorials for AnimationPlayer, AnimationTree, cutouts, and importing animated scenes.

title: OpenGameArt — Animations
author: OpenGameArt Community
summary: Filterable free animated sprites and 3D clips. Always double-check the license on each pack.

title: Kenney Animated Assets
author: Kenney
summary: CC0 animated packs from Kenney — drop into Godot with zero licensing stress.

title: Quaternius Animated Characters
author: Quaternius
summary: Stylized free 3D characters — many include idle/walk/run clips ready for Godot prototypes.
